evidence.title: UI Builder — Visual Editor for Your React App
GitHub - olliethedev/ui-builder: A React component that provides a no-code, visual way to create UIs, compatible with shadcn/ui and custom components. · GitHub

name: UI Builder
summary: Drop-in Figma-style visual editor that lets non-developers compose pages from your React components, saved as JSON.
description: A shadcn/ui package that embeds a Figma-style editor in your own product, letting non-developers compose pages, emails, dashboards and white-label views from the React components you already ship. Layouts are saved as plain JSON and rendered with dynamic data through variables; the editor supports custom component registries, drag-and-drop layers, panel configuration, editing restrictions and read-only mode. An optional shadcn registry adds all 54 official components and 124 block templates, plus React Email support for email templates. Docs at uibuilder.app; MIT licensed, part of BTST.
